Subject: MAP Draft & Next Steps (NovaHealth)

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet earlier today. Per our discovery, I pulled together a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) that outlines the milestones, owners, and an initial target close of 2026-04-30. Key highlights: 

- Pilot scope confirmed: inference of clinical summaries for 3 pilot clinics (Q1).
- Success criteria: latency <= 200ms p50 on 512 token loads; cost per 1k tokens target <$0.08.
- Dependencies: access to sample data (PHI redacted), SOC 2 docs, procurement process.

Attached: MAP_NovaHealth_v1.xlsx (draft). Could you review milestones & owners and flag any missing dependencies?

Proposed next steps:
1) Sarah to confirm procurement timeline and security reviewer (we heard Rajiv might lead security).
2) Marissa/Rishi to share dedicated sizing (GPU recommendations) and SOW draft by EOD next Wednesday.
3) Joint review 2-week cadence during pilot.

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP based on your feedback.

Best,
Marissa

From: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@novahealth.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP Draft & Next Steps (NovaHealth)

Thanks Marissa — great notes and appreciated the quick turnaround. A few updates from our side after checking with procurement and clinical ops:

- Procurement: they need a standard SOW and our legal needs to review data processing terms; procurement timeline now looks like ~8 weeks (not the 4 weeks we discussed).
- Security: Rajiv will be the primary security reviewer; he asked for SOC 2 Type II and network architecture diagrams.
- Pilot priority: clinical ops asked to postpone the second clinic to prioritize integrating with their EHR test instance first. That shortens the initial pilot to 1 clinic + EHR integration work.

Given procurement and security asks, we should reforecast the target close to 2026-06-30 and update milestones/dependencies accordingly. Can you send a reworked MAP with the new dates and owners? Also loop procurement (procurement@novahealth.com) when you have the SOW draft.

I’ll aim to get Rajiv’s availability for a security sync next week.

—Sarah
Director, Clinical Programs
NovaHealth

Hi Sarah / Rajiv —

Thanks for the clarity. I updated the MAP to reflect the reforecast and reprioritized milestones (attached: MAP_NovaHealth_v2_reforecast.xlsx). Summary of changes below: 

Updated target close: 2026-06-30 (was 2026-04-30).

Milestones (high-level):
- M1: SOW & procurement sign-off — Owner: Procurement (NovaHealth) / Rishi (Redwood) — Target: 2026-04-15 — Dependency: Legal review of DPA
- M2: SOC 2 & security review complete — Owner: Rajiv (NovaHealth) / Nikhil (Redwood) — Target: 2026-04-30 — Dependency: Network diagrams + SOC 2 evidence
- M3: EHR test instance integration + sample data delivery — Owner: Clinical Ops (NovaHealth) / Nikhil — Target: 2026-05-15 — Dependency: EHR credentials + sandbox access
- M4: Pilot run (1 clinic) + performance validation — Owner: Clinical Ops (NovaHealth) / Rishi — Target: 2026-06-10 — Dependency: Completed integration, infra sizing
- M5: Production readiness & go-live — Owner: NovaHealth / Redwood — Target: 2026-06-30

Actions for Redwood:
- Provide updated SOW draft with standard DPA clauses (Rishi) — ETA: 2026-03-05
- Share SOC 2 summary + redacted network diagram (Nikhil) — ETA: 2026-03-01
- Provide GPU sizing and cost estimate for pilot (Rishi/Nikhil) — ETA: 2026-03-05

Action items for NovaHealth:
- Confirm procurement sign-off date and who signs SOW — ETA: 2026-03-01
- Share EHR sandbox access details and sample (redacted) data — ETA: 2026-03-10

If that looks right I’ll mark this as MAP v2 and update our internal forecast. Please reply with any date/owner changes and I’ll iterate.

Thanks — attaching v2.

Best,
Marissa
